name: Babi
subtitle: Shadow of Duat
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: The baboon god represents the most violent, rapacious, and lustful aspects of that beast. Once he dwelt in Duat, consuming those souls who were deemed unworthy of the afterlife. The Shattering unleashed him upon the rest of Aaru, however. Now he devours anyone he considers sinful—and his definition of “sinful” varies based on how angry or hungry he might be.
